display_name: Apple Vision Pro (ALVR visionOS client), optimized visual quality
author: AirFrameXR project (the author's second profile, created on the 5090)

fov.name: AVP optimized quality
fov.note: Optimized visual quality: the field of view the games are told is 1.22 / 0.81 / 0.90 / 0.77 (outer / inner / upper / lower tangents, the author's profile of 2026-11-08), wider than AVP optimized performance (0.97 / 0.71 / 0.69 / 0.63): fewer black margins at the cost of more game pixels. A field of view only; the stream settings come from the headset profile.
